# Acceptance Criterion: [Criterion ID] - [Criterion Name]

## 1. Acceptance Criterion ID
[A unique, stable identifier for the acceptance criterion, e.g., AC-PORT-001. This ID will be referenced in feature specifications, tests, and pull requests.]

## 2. Criterion Name
[A concise, descriptive name for the acceptance criterion.]

## 3. Related Feature
[The feature this criterion belongs to, or a link to the Feature Specification.]

## 4. Related Business Rule(s)
[Any specific Business Rule IDs (e.g., BR-HLD-001) that this criterion is verifying.]

## 5. Scenario
[A brief description of the specific scenario or user flow being tested.]

## 6. Given
[The initial context or state of the system before the action occurs.]

## 7. When
[The specific action or event triggered by the user or system.]

## 8. Then
[The expected observable outcome or state change in the system.]

## 9. And / Additional Conditions
[Any additional preconditions or postconditions (e.g., side effects, database state, fired events).]

## 10. Expected Result
[A concrete, testable description of the successful outcome.]

## 11. Error / Rejection Behavior (when applicable)
[Expected system behavior when the action fails, is invalid, or violates a business rule. Include specific HTTP status codes or error messages if defined by the requirement.]

## 12. Authorization / Ownership Expectation (when applicable)
[Explicit description of who can and cannot perform this action, ensuring cross-user access is appropriately denied.]

## 13. Financial Calculation / Expected Value (when applicable)
[Specific expected financial outcomes or calculation results. Do not invent formulas here; refer to Business Rules and state the expected concrete values for testing.]

## 14. Edge Cases
[Boundary values, missing inputs, zero states, or unexpected user behavior that must be explicitly verified.]

## 15. Related Test
[References to the automated test suite (e.g., class and method names) that implements this acceptance criterion.]

## 16. Status
[Status of the acceptance criterion. Valid values: Proposed | Confirmed | Rejected | Implemented]
